title: Potion of Feather Fall
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to ignore falling damage for 10 turns. Throw as an Action to share the effect in a 3 ft radius.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle for Feather Fall on yourself.
fields.Throw: Action. Throw one bottle up to 60 ft to apply Feather Fall to creatures within 3 ft of the impact point.
fields.Duration: 10 turns. Fall more slowly and take no falling damage. Feather Fall also prevents the Prone result of a long drop.
fields.Crafting: Extract three Autumncrocus into Sublimate of Autumn Crocus and add any Essence.
fields.Creative use: Gather allies before a controlled drop and splash the group.
fields.Base value: 13 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Acquisition: Available from various merchants, enemies, and locations.

changes: Added source-reviewed native BG3 gameplay, consumption, and crafting details.
